prompt: Fixed camera, framing unchanged. The man in the navy gilet in the foreground sits cross-legged with his eyes shut, his fist at his mouth; immediately his lips murmur quickly behind his hand as he whispers into the phone tucked in his shirt cuff, his head bowing a fraction toward his wrist, shoulders hunched.
